notes.title: PATCH NOTE #2 : New Three Challenges
notes.notes:
Greetings,
Three new challenges are added and some bugs are fixed in this patch.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Challenge Mode - Hammer
Defeat the dashing enemies with your hammer.
[*]Challenge Mode - Target
Shot an arrow and hit the target.
[*]Challenge Mode - Chu-ko nu
Your enemies will fall before you by your chu-ko nu.
[/list]

[h1]Changes & Fixed[/h1]
Some minor bugs are fixed.

notes.title: Battle of Red Cliffs will be Start Soon!
notes.notes:
Our dev team is excited to announce that Battle of Red Cliffs VR is launching November 2, 2017 on Steam! Any players who have HTC Vive or Oculus Touch can play this game.
